config_assets.note: Loaded by openpi when building the train config; the checkpoint's own norm stats (identical) take precedence.

checkpoint_features.action_semantics: absolute joint position targets (server applies AbsoluteActions) + gripper closure

deployment_status: trained on DROID Panda + Robotiq 2F-85; zero-shot FR3 + Franka Hand transfer is unqualified
serving_rule: Serve with scripts/serve_openpi_policy.py from an openpi checkout at upstream_commit in its own environment. It verifies the checkout, checkpoint tree and tokenizer, then publishes server_identity metadata that the client requires. tree_sha256 hashes sorted relative paths and file SHA-256s (learning.integrations.openpi.checkpoint.tree_digest).
